title: Searches for Binary Mergers with Sub-solar Mass Components in Data from the First Part of LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA’s Fourth Observing Run Calibration of the LIGO strain data was performed with a GstLAL -based calibration software pipeline ( 142 ) . Data-quality products and event-validation results were computed using the DMT ( 147 ) , DQR ( 95 ) , DQSEGDB ( 71 ) , gwdetchar ( 139 ) , hveto ( 134 ) , iDQ ( 68 ) , Omicron ( 122 ) , PEMCHECK ( 83 ) and PythonVirgoTools ( 143 ) software packages and contributing software tools. Analyses in this catalog relied upon the LALSuite software library ( 96 ; 146 ) . The detection of the signal candidates and subsequent significance evaluations in this paper were performed with the GstLAL -based inspiral software pipeline ( 101 ; 126 ; 77 ; 46 ) , with the MBTA pipeline ( 27 ; 31 ) , and with the PyCBC ( 140 ; 110 ; 63 ) . Sensitive Hypervolume calculations were performed using GWPopulation ( 137 ) . Plots were prepared with Matplotlib ( 84 ) , seaborn ( 145 ) and GWpy ( 98 ) . NumPy ( 80 ) , SciPy ( 144 ) and Pandas ( 115 ) were used in the preparation of the manuscript.
